query: What contingency plans, BOM line-items (sensors, spares, UAV/LiDAR ops), staffing role matrix, and community compensation lines will mitigate permit denial, theft, or extreme weather risks?

response.query: What contingency plans, BOM line-items (sensors, spares, UAV/LiDAR ops), staffing role matrix, and community compensation lines will mitigate permit denial, theft, or extreme weather risks?
response.answer: Contingency plans include real-time weather monitoring, secure storage for sensors and spares, and UAV/LiDAR operations on standby. Staffing roles focus on security and rapid response teams. Community compensation covers theft and weather-related damages.
